page.overview:
Who is Dwarf?

The Dwarf is a fictional demon in the prime reality of the Marvel universe of Marvel Comics who was created in 1992 by Chris Cooper and Richard Case, first appearing in issue #28 of the 3rd volume of Ghost Rider.

The Dwarf is a demon which serves the Elder God Chthon. It delivers pages of the Darkhold in black envelopes to people, sometimes giving them little to no inkling of what it contains or what it's for and other times promising much if they use the page.

It can magically transport itself to anywhere it wants. Usually appearing wherever a Darkhold page is found. To get people to use a Darkhold page and thereby damn their souls, it influences them. The Dwarf prefers manipulating others to directly attacking them.
